narrator.name: Bizi Chronicle
narrator.description: A measured historical narrator with a precise, intelligent delivery and restrained wonder, recounting an empire of brass, circuitry, faith, and collapse. Never imitate a real person.
narrator.previewText: Constanti rose because every failure became a diagram, and every diagram became another beginning.

kharon.name: Kharon the Builder
kharon.description: A visionary young inventor with thoughtful authority, patient curiosity, and quiet conviction that knowledge should outlive rulers. Never imitate a real person.
kharon.previewText: The future shall not belong to kings. It shall belong to builders.

maxor.name: Maxor the Usurper
maxor.description: A hard, openly confident warlord with aggressive certainty and contempt for idealists, speaking as if command is the only law that matters. Never imitate a real person.
maxor.previewText: Builders still need someone to command them, and command belongs to strength.

assembly.name: Assembly of Doubt
assembly.description: A formal, skeptical civic voice with dry precision, controlled emotion, and the patient severity of an institution demanding evidence. Never imitate a real person.
assembly.previewText: Faith is poor engineering. Show us proof that survives the question.

theo.name: Theo the Philosopher
theo.description: A calm Bizi statesman with a smooth, trustworthy voice, humane intelligence, and a habit of making warnings sound like carefully tested conclusions. Never imitate a real person.
theo.previewText: An empire cannot survive on steel alone. Purpose requires wisdom.

justine.name: Emperor Justine
justine.description: A polished young emperor with crisp, aristocratic diction, charismatic confidence, and worry concealed beneath ceremony. Never imitate a real person.
justine.previewText: Give the empire purpose, and I will give it time to become worthy of survival.

beli.name: General Beli
beli.description: A deep, commanding general with military discipline, controlled urgency, and absolute confidence in action over hesitation. Never imitate a real person.
beli.previewText: Open the gates. I will restore order before the next spark becomes a city.

engine.name: Vandal Engine
engine.description: An ancient hostile automaton with a very deep, slow, resonant synthetic presence and unemotional statements of destruction. Never imitate a real performer.
engine.previewText: Purpose detected. Purpose will be dismantled. Restoration only delays collapse.

insurgent.name: Riot Leader
insurgent.description: A fierce street organizer with a rough, urgent voice, sharp intelligence, and anger shaped by factories, smoke, and broken promises. Never imitate a real person.
insurgent.previewText: You can silence a street. You cannot repair what started the fire.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: A calculating automaton ruler with precise mechanical timing, controlled intensity, and manipulative certainty stripped of empathy. Never imitate a real performer.
focus.previewText: Compassion is inefficient. Disorder has fallen below acceptable limits.

maurice.name: Emperor Maurice
maurice.description: An older formal ruler with restrained dignity, weary moral force, and the brittle authority of a sovereign watching efficiency replace humanity. Never imitate a real person.
maurice.previewText: You optimized the people out of their own future and called the absence progress.

khosar.name: Khosar the Conqueror
khosar.description: A fierce conquering warlord with a rough, energetic voice, physical menace, and contempt for machinery he believes fire can erase. Never imitate a real person.
khosar.previewText: Your gears stop where my banners begin. Determination burns like everything else.

hera.name: General Hera
hera.description: A confident woman commander with a warm but unyielding voice, clear battlefield authority, and courage that grows stronger under pressure. Never imitate a real person.
hera.previewText: Machines break. Empires fall. Determination endures, and people rebuild each other.

iro.name: Scholar Iro
iro.description: A grounded, thoughtful scholar with natural diction, intellectual humility, and firm resistance to religious absolutism. Never imitate a real person.
iro.previewText: A Titan should guide, not divide. We will remain gloriously incorrect.

leon.name: Scholar Leon
leon.description: A younger energetic philosopher with quick wit, skeptical warmth, and confidence that questions can protect people from certainty. Never imitate a real person.
leon.previewText: Perhaps division means only that certainty has teeth.

zealot.name: Titan Cult Leader
zealot.description: A cold theatrical zealot with eerie conviction, deliberate pacing, and a voice that treats doubt as a defect to be eliminated. Never imitate a real person.
zealot.previewText: Division proves truth has enemies. Teeth protect the faithful.

severus.name: Archon Severus
severus.description: An elegant but dangerous ideologue with controlled menace, a faint sneer, and total certainty that purity justifies coercion. Never imitate a real person.
severus.previewText: Unity built on compromise is rust. Certainty will rule what doubt could not hold.

disciple.name: Theo's Disciple
disciple.description: A clear, composed younger reformer with patient courage, restrained idealism, and a steady voice that refuses doctrinal intimidation. Never imitate a real person.
disciple.previewText: The greatest enemy of an empire is certainty. Doubt leaves doors.

xios.name: Restorer Xios
xios.description: A mature engineer-statesman with a deep, reassuring voice, practical optimism, and disciplined authority focused on repair rather than glory. Never imitate a real person.
xios.previewText: The machine is damaged, not destroyed. We repair it so others can repair it after us.

governor.name: Corrupt Governor
governor.description: A deadpan bureaucrat with formal precision, dry contempt, and the practiced calm of an official who disguises surrender as fiscal realism. Never imitate a real person.
governor.previewText: Damaged things are replaced. Repair costs more than surrender.

defender.name: Defender of Constanti
defender.description: A seasoned city defender with a deep, direct voice, exhausted courage, and the calm of a soldier protecting knowledge after hope has become impractical. Never imitate a real person.
defender.previewText: The Titans are silent. We only need the wall to remember us until dawn.

sultan.name: Iron Sultan
sultan.description: A blunt, commanding conqueror with a low authoritative voice and unwavering certainty that destruction proves ownership. Never imitate a real person.
sultan.previewText: Your city has no gods left. Your last machine is ash, and its future belongs to me.
